from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
root=Path.cwd()
profile=json.loads(Path('build-local/glm-warm-profile.json').read_text())
profile['env']['STRATA_GLM_CACHE_SLAB_MIB']='16'
profile['env']['STRATA_GLM_EXPERT_PROFILE']=str(root/'build-local/glm-warm-learned.json')
profile['env']['STRATA_GLM_EXPERT_PROFILE_READ_ONLY']='1'
profile['log']=str(root/'build-local/glm-warm-pipe.engine.log')
selected=Path('build-local/glm-warm-selected.json')
selected.write_text(json.dumps(profile,indent=2)+'\n')
reference=json.loads(Path('docs/GLM53/GLM53_FLASH_SYNC_REPEAT.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(profile['env']);env['PATH']=';'.join(profile['lib_dirs'])+';'+env.get('PATH','')
binary=root/'build-local/glm5next-candidate-cuda/bin/strata-glm5next-smoke.exe'
args=[str(binary),'--model',profile['args'][1],'--input-ids',','.join(map(str,reference['prompt_ids'])),'--ctx','2048','--batch','16','--n-predict','64','--ram-target-percent','95','--vram-target-percent','95','--expert-pipeline','1','--expert-chunk-mib','4','--logits','build-local/glm-warm-real.f32','--report','build-local/glm-warm-real.json']
print('START real MTP-off logits',flush=True)
with open('build-local/glm-warm-real.log','w',encoding='utf-8') as out:
    result=subprocess.run(args,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert result.returncode==0,result.returncode
report=json.loads(Path('build-local/glm-warm-real.json').read_text())
assert report['status']=='pass' and report['generated_ids']==reference['generated_ids']
a=Path('build-local/glm-warm-real.f32').read_bytes();b=Path('build-local/glm-sync-iq3-repeat.f32').read_bytes()
assert a==b and len(a)==9912320*4,'saved logits differ'
report['baseline_comparison']={'bit_exact':True,'elements':len(a)//4,'baseline':'build-local/glm-sync-iq3-repeat.f32','sha256':hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()}
report['command']=args;report['environment']=profile['env']
Path('docs/GLM53/GLM53_FLASH_WARM_CHECK.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('PASS 9,912,320 F32 values bit-exact; token IDs exact',flush=True)
for name,tool in [('pipe','tools/check_glm5next_engine.py'),('api','tools/check_glm5next_api.py')]:
    profile['log']=str(root/f'build-local/glm-warm-{name}.engine.log')
    selected.write_text(json.dumps(profile,indent=2)+'\n')
    args=[sys.executable,tool,'--profile',str(selected),'--reference','docs/GLM53/GLM53_FLASH_SYNC_REPEAT.json','--output',f'build-local/glm-warm-{name}.json']
    print('START',name,flush=True)
    with open(f'build-local/glm-warm-{name}.log','w',encoding='utf-8') as out:
        result=subprocess.run(args,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    assert result.returncode==0,(name,result.returncode)
    print('PASS',name,flush=True)

limits: Three engine restarts per mode, alternating order. One trained prompt and one unseen prompt, 64 output tokens each; OS file cache was not cleared. This is not a storage cold-start benchmark.
Read timings include host memcpy and page faults; disk I/O and hard versus soft faults were not isolated. Large latency outliers prevent claiming a stable throughput improvement.
The five-repeat warm medians are descriptive, not a new best speed claim. Prior 11.764 tok/s belongs to the earlier P3.3e session.
All real tests keep MTP off and targets 95%; these are sampled global targets, not atomic reservations. Power was not measured.
Metadata checkpoint is outside DONE.decode_ms but inside benchmark request wall time. Training writes were tested; comparison/real-check hints were frozen.

Thirty-one A requests match the saved independent run. The first B-off request establishes a new B reference; the five following B requests match it. Unseen B has only one process per mode, in off/learned order.
Model identity uses path/size/mtime and tensor layout, not a full GGUF checksum. Only placement is learned; model routing, weights, arithmetic and conversation state are unchanged.
Long contexts, Linux/HIP, real Qwen/DeepSeek and P4 session reuse were not tested in this round.
